name: Gather
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Gather, build a small spatial web room with basic movement and text presence. The hard boundary is real-time spatial media, maps, integrations, moderation, and hosted capacity, plus network, moderation, and communication infrastructure.
